title: Riot Squad | PUNX | Apple Cucumber Mint 60ml
description:
Riot Squad | PUNX | Apple Cucumber Mint 60ml
The Punx range is from renowned UK e-liquid brand Riot Squad, with this collection dedicated to layered fruit combinations with a punk theme.
Apple, Cucumber, Mint & Aniseed shortfill e-liquid by Riot Squad Punx is a garden fruit blend known for its cooling yet bold undertones. A crisp apple is complemented by a chilled cucumber and mint, before a pungent aniseed wraps things up for a complex vape.
